Restoring will OVERWRITE the current &TERMUX_APP_NAME; data directory (installed packages and your home directory) with the contents of the selected backup file. Existing data will be LOST.

⚠ If the restore fails — because the backup file is corrupted, incomplete, or the connection is interrupted during the process — your &TERMUX_APP_NAME; environment will be LEFT EMPTY. There will be no way to recover the original data.

This cannot be undone. It is strongly recommended to back up FIRST and verify the backup file is valid.
